title: DAMOS: Learning Distortion-Aware Speech Quality Assessment through Explicit Distortion Localization
abstract: arXiv:2608.21176v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic speech quality assessment aims to predict Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) consistent with human subjective perception and is essential for evaluating speech generation, enhancement, and communication systems. For speech signals, especially synthetic speech, distortions often occur locally, and overall perceptual quality is usually dominated by a small number of perceptually salient distortion regions. However, most existing methods are primarily optimized with utterance-level MOS, which provides only coarse-grained supervision and offer no explicit indication of where perceptually important distortions occur. To address this limitation, we introduce explicit distortion localization as auxiliary knowledge for speech quality assessment. translated_title: DAMOS：通过显式失真定位学习失真感知的语音质量评估
translated_abstract: 自动语音质量评估旨在预测与人类主观感知一致的平均意见得分（MOS），这对于评估语音生成、增强和通信系统至关重要。对于语音信号，尤其是合成语音，失真往往局部发生，整体感知质量通常由少数感知上显著的失真区域主导。然而，大多数现有方法主要使用话语级别的MOS进行优化，这仅提供粗粒度的监督，并且没有明确指示感知上重要的失真发生在何处。为解决这一局限性，我们引入显式失真定位作为语音质量评估的辅助知识。我们构建了第一个具有帧级失真标注的部分失真语音数据集，并训练一个定位模型来生成失真提示。基于这些提示，我们提出了DAMOS，这是一种失真感知的语音质量评估方法。
tldr: 本文提出DAMOS，通过显式失真定位提供辅助监督，以帧级标注和定位模型生成失真提示，从而改善语音质量评估对局部感知显著失真的捕捉能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DAMOS, which leverages explicit distortion localization as auxiliary supervision, using frame-level annotations and a localization model to generate distortion cues, thereby improving speech quality assessment's ability to capture perceptually salient local distortions.
